context: A small retail shop wants to replace manual inventory notes and spreadsheets with a simple inventory management system. The student interviews the shop owner to understand stock tracking, daily operations, supplier handling, reporting, permissions, and offline needs.

requirements.text: Staff must be able to view current stock levels for each product.
Staff must be able to record stock-in and stock-out transactions.
requirements.reveal_condition: Question about receiving or removing stock.

requirements.text: The system should alert the owner when product stock falls below a configurable threshold.
requirements.reveal_condition: Question about low stock or reorder alerts.

requirements.text: The system should support barcode scanning for faster product lookup.
requirements.reveal_condition: Question about faster product lookup or barcode scanning.

requirements.text: The system must support creating purchase orders for suppliers.
requirements.reveal_condition: Question about suppliers or reordering stock.

requirements.text: The inventory system should integrate with the existing sales system to reduce manual updates.
Only the owner can edit product cost prices and supplier information.
requirements.reveal_condition: Question about permission or sensitive inventory data.

requirements.text: The system should generate daily stock movement and low-stock reports.
The system should continue recording transactions during temporary internet outages and sync later.
requirements.reveal_condition: Question about offline use or internet outages.
